subject: info-dy
title: (R)INFO.DY.------EXP.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 441 (TRF(CW)-13). INFO-DY is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental), C-CONT (composite continuance) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From PER-PHY-U-FUND: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From C-CONT: C-RH (composite research). From C-RH: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From CULT-AF-BS: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From T-C-IMP: STF (source transfer). From STF: LK-IMP (linkage implications).
